source: PCGamingWiki's List of unofficial ports (console sections), each project checked; see docs/recomps.md

entries.name: Cannonball

needs.what: The OutRun arcade ROM set, revision B (the MAME outrun set's files, unzipped); Japanese ROMs optional for the Japanese tracks

setup.place: roms/ beside the program (the OutRun revision B files, e.g. epr-10187.88, mpr-10371.9 ...)
setup.notes: Paths to the roms and res folders are set in config.xml and default to the working directory. Only a Windows build is released (maintained by the author); Linux users build it themselves.

saves: hiscores.xml and the other hiscores_*.xml in data.savepath (default the working directory)
entries.description: An enhanced engine for the OutRun arcade game, rewritten in C++ from the original 68000 and Z80 code, with widescreen and higher frame rates.

entries.name: ProjectR

needs.what: Arcade dumps: for The Rock an sfrushrk CHD or raw hard drive dump plus the four audio ROMs (audio.u62, u61, u53, u49, a ZIP of them is accepted); for Rush 2049 an sf2049se, sf2049te or sf2049tea image

setup.arg: --rtr starts The Rock, --2049 starts Rush 2049 (main menu if not set up)
setup.notes: Each game is set up from the main menu's setup option. Needs Vulkan 1.2 and an x86-64-v2 CPU. Controller or wheel, no keyboard and mouse.

entries.description: An unofficial native PC port of the San Francisco Rush arcade games The Rock and 2049, using your own arcade dumps.

entries.name: Metroid Planets

setup.notes: A stand-alone Windows fan remake (no ROM needed); on Linux it runs through Wine or Proton.

entries.description: A fan remake of the original Metroid by vacantshade, with new areas and modern controls.

entries.name: Super Mario Bros. Remastered

needs.what: An original Super Mario Bros. NES ROM (.nes), checked against the project's own hashes

setup.notes: Takes -rom <path>, else the first .nes beside the program, else asks (file dialog or drop). The ROM is copied to baserom.nes in its config folder, then assets are extracted to resource_packs/BaseAssets. Portable mode: portable.txt beside the program puts everything in config/ there.

entries.achievements: ~/.local/share/SMB1R/achievements.sav: a text string of 0/1 characters, one per achievement
entries.description: A Godot remake of Super Mario Bros. and The Lost Levels with new characters, modes and a level editor, built from your NES ROM.

entries.name: SuperMarioBros-C

needs.what: An unmodified Super Mario Bros. (JU) (PRG0) [!].nes ROM

setup.place: Super Mario Bros. (JU) (PRG0) [!].nes
setup.notes: Looked for in the working folder; another path can be set as rom_file in smbc.conf (INI) in the working folder.

entries.description: Super Mario Bros. translated from 6502 assembly into C++, a static recompilation that still emulates the PPU and APU.

entries.name: ZQuest Classic

setup.notes: Formerly Zelda Classic. Ships its own recreation of the original quest plus an editor (zeditor) and player (zplayer). Stable tags are 2.55.x; 3.0.0 prereleases and nightlies are also published.

saves: saves (relative to the program folder, config key [zeldadx] save_folder)
entries.description: A recreation of the original Legend of Zelda engine with a quest editor and thousands of fan-made quests.

setup.place: sm.smc
setup.notes: Reads sm.smc from the working folder, or the first argument. Early version, build it yourself.

The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess

needs.what: A Twilight Princess disc image, GameCube or Wii (any commercial disc except the Korean Wii release)

setup.notes: A pre-launch screen asks for the disc image with a file dialog, verifies it and remembers the path in its settings (backend.isoPath). With a Wii disc the GameCube version's layout is presented. Needs D3D12, Vulkan 1.1+ or Metal.

saves: GCI files in its memory card folder (exact Linux location not confirmed)
entries.description: A reverse-engineered reimplementation of Twilight Princess built on the decompilation, with enhancements and mod support.

entries.name: forest

needs.what: The US Animal Crossing disc image (GAFE01, revision 0)

setup.notes: Work-in-progress PC port; must be built from source, with the disc image copied to orig/GAFE01_00 at build time. No releases or tags.

entries.description: A work-in-progress PC port of Animal Crossing for the GameCube, built on the decompilation.

entries.name: Foxhollow

needs.what: A Star Fox Adventures GameCube disc image (any copy)

setup.notes: Players use the official launcher (Linux launcher AppImage on cdn.foxhollow.dev), which downloads and updates the game, manages memory cards and offers mods. The game program itself (foxhollow, published per release to the CDN as foxhollow-<tag>-linux.tar.gz) takes the disc path as its first argument or FOXHOLLOW_DISC. FOXHOLLOW_MEMORY_CARD and FOXHOLLOW_USER_DIR set the save and user folders.

saves: memory cards managed by the launcher (FOXHOLLOW_MEMORY_CARD path; default location not confirmed)
entries.description: A native port of Star Fox Adventures built on the SFA decompilation and Aurora, delivered through its own launcher.

entries.name: Metaforce

needs.what: A Metroid Prime GameCube disc image

setup.notes: Takes the disc image as its first positional argument; without it a file dialog asks for the image at every start. Builds are currently unavailable while the rewrite on the matching decompilation stabilises; CI builds a Metaforce-*.AppImage for Linux. The only GitHub release (p12) is an outdated HECL prototype extractor, not the game.

entries.description: A reimplementation of the Metroid Prime engine, now rebuilt on the matching decompilation, for Windows, macOS, Linux and mobile.

entries.name: Party Board

needs.what: The US Mario Party 4 disc image (GMPE01, revision 0) as .iso or .rvz

setup.place: the disc image renamed to GMPE01_00 in the program folder
setup.notes: If the image is not in the folder it asks to browse for it at every start. Alpha builds; a controller is required; the x64 build may crash in more places than x86. Releases before 0.1.1 needed the disc's files extracted with Dolphin into GMPE01_00/files.

saves: %APPDATA%/Party Board (inside the Proton prefix: drive_c/users/steamuser/AppData/Roaming/Party Board); Dolphin-compatible save from 0.2.0
entries.description: An early alpha native PC port of Mario Party 4, built from the community decompilation.

entries.name: Pokémon Platinum PC Port

needs.what: The US Pokémon Platinum DS ROM (CPUE01) as an .nds file

setup.notes: On first launch a dialog asks for the .nds ROM and its contents are extracted into the program folder; after that the game starts directly. The Linux zip holds pokeplatinum.AppImage, main, firmware.bin and header.bin. Swapping msgdata/msg.narc, msgdata/pl_msg.narc and msgdata/scenario/scr_msg.narc from another language changes most text. Tilde opens settings and debug tools.

entries.description: An experimental native PC port of Pokémon Platinum built on the pret decompilation and the libntr libraries, playable start to finish.

entries.name: Kirby Wii Recomp

needs.what: The North American Kirby's Return to Dream Land disc image (SUKE01) as WBFS or ISO

setup.notes: KirbyWiiRecomp is a launcher: pick the disc image in it and it extracts the game into its data folder, sets up a sideways Wii Remote profile for a connected controller, chooses an audio backend and starts KirbyRecomp. The disc image is not modified. The Linux zip has one top folder KirbyWiiRecomp/ with bundled libraries in lib/. Built on the ModernGekko GameCube/Wii recomp runtime (Dolphin based).

saves: kirby-wii-recomp data folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\kirby-wii-recomp on Windows; Linux location not confirmed, probably ~/.local/share/kirby-wii-recomp)
entries.description: A static recompilation of Kirby's Return to Dream Land on the ModernGekko runtime, with a launcher that sets up the game from your disc image.

entries.name: WiiCompiled

needs.what: A clean, unmodified PAL Mario Kart Wii disc image (RMCP01); other regions and patched executables are rejected

setup.notes: The release is a command-line setup tool, not the game: it verifies and extracts the disc, then statically recompiles and builds the native game on this machine (about 20 GB free during install, about 5 GB after; it takes a long time). Default install folder ~/.local/share/WiiCompiled/Install/Base (Retro Rewind: Install/RetroRewind with --retro-dir). Start it with 'launch-base' or 'launch-retro'. Wheel Wizard is the official front end.

entries.description: A native PC port of Mario Kart Wii by static recompilation, built on your own machine from your PAL disc by its setup tool, with Retro Rewind support.

entries.name: Sonic 3 A.I.R.

needs.what: The Sonic 3 & Knuckles ROM from the Steam release (Sega Classics), Sonic_Knuckles_wSonic3.bin, 4 MB

setup.place: Sonic_Knuckles_wSonic3.bin in ~/.local/share/Sonic3AIR/ (or next to sonic3air_linux, or the path in config.json RomPath)
setup.notes: On Linux there is no file picker: if the ROM is not found it shows an error and closes. It looks in its app data folder, the last known ROM path, config.json RomPath, the working folder, then Steam's 'steamapps/common/Sega Classics/uncompressed ROMs/' (native and Flatpak Steam). A ROM found elsewhere is copied into ~/.local/share/Sonic3AIR/. The ROM is checked by size (0x400000) and a Murmur2 64-bit checksum, not md5.

saves: ~/.local/share/Sonic3AIR/storage/ (persistent data) and ~/.local/share/Sonic3AIR/savestates/; uses ./savedata beside the program instead if that folder exists
entries.achievements: Has its own in-game achievements, kept with its persistent data in ~/.local/share/Sonic3AIR/ (format not checked)
entries.description: A fan-made widescreen remaster of Sonic 3 & Knuckles running the original game's logic as scripts in its own Oxygen engine, with mods and many extras.

entries.name: Streets of Rage 2 New Era

needs.what: A Streets of Rage 2 Mega Drive ROM (the developers suggest the one from the Steam release)

setup.notes: On first launch it asks for the ROM path and a mods folder. Downloads are a zip per platform from its own site (Linux build named like 'SOR2 NE 3.1.0 Linux.zip'). Unity game, no emulation; adds 4-player local and online co-op, widescreen and a 30th Anniversary mode.

entries.achievements: Has its own in-game achievements (format and file not known)
entries.description: A fan rebuild of Streets of Rage 2 in Unity that reads the original ROM, with widescreen, online co-op for four players and an anniversary mode.

entries.name: Crash Bandicoot: Recompiled

needs.what: The NTSC-U PlayStation disc of Crash Bandicoot (SCUS-94900) as a .chd or a .cue with one MODE2/2352 .bin track

setup.notes: The launcher's Select disc button picks the image (a disc in the program's folder is found on its own). The first start recompiles the game from the disc into game/ beside the program, which takes a minute or two. The image must stay in place: levels and audio stream from it. --prepare builds without playing. The download is a single file; chmod +x is needed.

entries.description: A launcher that statically recompiles your own Crash Bandicoot disc with RecompOne and plays it natively, with widescreen, high frame rates, 4K and mods.

entries.name: CTR Native

needs.what: The NTSC-U PlayStation disc of Crash Team Racing as a single-track raw .bin (MODE2/2352, data track from byte 0); a cooked .iso will not do

setup.place: assets/ctr-u.bin
setup.notes: Reads the game straight from the image; extracted files in assets/ override it for modding. Single static 32-bit executable with SDL3 built in.

entries.description: A native PC port of Crash Team Racing built on the CTR-ModSDK decompilation, as a single executable that reads your own disc image.

entries.name: LSD: Revamped

setup.notes: Downloads are on itch.io only (no GitHub releases). Unzip into one folder and run LSDR.x86_64.

entries.description: A fan-made remake of LSD: Dream Emulator in Unity, with the game's content included and support for mods.

entries.name: MediEvil Recomp

needs.what: The North American (NTSC-U, SCUS-94227) PlayStation disc of MediEvil as a .cue with its two .bin tracks, or a .chd

setup.notes: Built on the same RecompOne runtime as SymphonyRecomp: on first start a disc picker pop-up asks for the .cue or .chd and saves it as CdPath in settings.json in the working folder. MediEvil sets no disc check of its own, so any readable image is accepted. run.sh installs the .NET 10 runtime into ~/.dotnet if missing, then starts the medievil program. It has its own auto-updater.

saves: carda.sav and cardb.sav (memory cards) in the working folder
entries.license: MIT (RecompOne runtime); no licence file in MediEvilRecomp
entries.description: Static recompilation of MediEvil for PlayStation, with widescreen and better rendering options.

entries.name: PsyDoom

needs.what: A PlayStation disc of Doom or Final Doom (any region or edition, also the demo disc or GEC Master Edition beta 3/4) as a .cue with its .bin

setup.notes: The disc can also be picked in its built-in launcher window or set as CueFilePath in game_cfg.ini; relative paths are relative to the working folder. Linux sound needs PulseAudio.

saves: ~/.local/share/com.codelobster/PsyDoom/ (Save1.sav to Save3.sav, Quick.sav, Auto.sav with a per-game prefix, plus the .ini config files)
entries.description: PlayStation Doom and Final Doom reverse engineered from the original machine code into native C++, with a Vulkan renderer, link-cable multiplayer over the network and mods.

entries.name: ReChan

needs.what: The NTSC-U PlayStation disc of Jackie Chan Stuntmaster (SLUS-00684) as a .bin or .iso image

setup.place: discimage/<any name>.bin or .iso (only one image in the folder)
setup.notes: On first launch it checks the disc's boot file is SLUS-00684 and extracts the assets beside the program (folders xc, fe, tim and license.tim); the disc image can be deleted afterwards.

saves: userfiles/jcsSAVE<n>.sav and userfiles/jcsAUTOSAVE.sav (relative to the program folder)
entries.description: Jackie Chan Stuntmaster rewritten in C++ for PC, with widescreen, higher resolutions and PC settings.

entries.name: REDRIVER2

needs.what: Both discs of the PAL English (SLES-02993/SLES-12993) or NTSC US (SLUS-01161/SLUS-01318) PlayStation version of Driver 2, each as a single .bin image

setup.place: install/Driver2CD1.bin and install/Driver2CD2.bin
setup.notes: config.ini [cdfs] image=install/Driver2CD1.bin reads the game from disc 1. Movies and audio must then be extracted once with _convert_cd_fmv_xa.sh, which runs jpsxdec and needs Java. Needs SDL2 and OpenAL from the system.

entries.description: Driver 2 for PlayStation disassembled and rewritten in C, running natively with bugs fixed and unfinished parts completed.

entries.name: Severed Chains

needs.what: All four discs of the North American PlayStation version of The Legend of Dragoon (SCUS-94491, 94584, 94585, 94586) as .iso or .bin images

setup.place: isos/ (any file names, one image per disc)
setup.notes: On first start it reads each image's disc ID (PAL and Japanese discs are refused) and unpacks the assets into files/. The launch script downloads a Java 25 runtime into jdk25/ the first time (Steam Deck build opens it in Konsole). Java cannot start from a path containing a colon.

saves: saves/ (*.dsav, relative to the program folder)
entries.description: The Legend of Dragoon rewritten in Java for PC, with assets read from your own discs, mods and many improvements.

entries.name: SymphonyRecomp

needs.what: The North American (NTSC-U, SLUS-00067) PlayStation disc of Castlevania: Symphony of the Night as a .cue with its .bin tracks, or a .chd

setup.notes: On first start a disc picker pop-up asks for the .cue or .chd; the path is saved as CdPath in settings.json in the working folder and checked for SLUS_000.67. run.sh installs the .NET 10 runtime into ~/.dotnet if missing, then starts the sotn program.

saves: carda.sav and cardb.sav (memory cards) in the working folder
entries.license: MIT (RecompOne runtime); no licence file in SymphonyRecomp
entries.description: Static recompilation of Castlevania: Symphony of the Night for PlayStation, with widescreen, quality of life options, a randomiser and mods.

entries.name: WipeOut Phantom Edition

needs.what: The USA PlayStation disc of Wipeout as a .cue with its nine .bin tracks (or the 517 game files copied from the disc)

setup.place: wipeout/diskimages/ (the .cue and all .bin tracks)
setup.notes: On start it extracts missing data files and the music from the image (a slow hash-based search on machines with under 8 cores). Loose files can go in wipeout/wipeoutgame and music in wipeout/music. The image can be removed once the main menu has loaded once. Runs through Proton (Proton Experimental suggested).

entries.description: An enhanced PC source port of the PlayStation Wipeout, using the PlayStation game data, with uncapped frame rate, widescreen and higher resolutions.

entries.name: wipEout Rewrite

needs.what: The game data of the NTSC PlayStation Wipeout (files from the disc, not the image) plus some menu models from the PC version; music as .qoa and the intro as MPEG1 are optional

setup.place: wipeout/ beside the program (wipeout/textures/, wipeout/music/track01.qoa ...)
setup.notes: Assets are read from SDL_GetBasePath (the program folder) unless built with PATH_ASSETS. Analogue sticks must be bound in Options.

entries.description: A re-implementation of the 1995 PlayStation game Wipeout in C, with widescreen, higher frame rates and a browser version.

entries.name: 3SX

needs.what: The PlayStation 2 disc of Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike or Street Fighter Anniversary Collection as an .iso (only THIRD/SF33RD.AFS is used)

setup.place: ~/.local/share/CrowdedStreet/3SX/resources/SF33RD.AFS
setup.notes: The start-up wizard opens a file dialog for the .iso and copies THIRD/SF33RD.AFS into the resources folder; it can also be copied there by hand. The AFS is checked by SHA-256 f9fa50f3a124ec9fa9465aa9c8546c2d867887eb39f711a070762a0324ba5604.

entries.description: A native PC port of Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike built from the decompiled PlayStation 2 version, with rollback netplay and modern controller support.

entries.name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories PC Edition

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories

needs.what: A clean, unmodded PC install of Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas (the mod is a total conversion of it, not built from the console game)

setup.notes: Total-conversion mod for the PC version of GTA: San Andreas (codename Blue Hesper), distributed on ModDB as an installer of about 768 MB; the team suggests installing into a new folder rather than the San Andreas one. Windows only, through Proton.

entries.description: A fan total-conversion mod that recreates Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories inside the PC version of Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas.

entries.name: Half-Life: Decay

needs.what: A PC copy of Half-Life (Steam or otherwise) to run the mod in; the PS2 game itself is not used

setup.place: the decay folder in the Half-Life root folder (next to valve/)
setup.notes: A GoldSrc mod: pick it under Change Game in Half-Life, or restart Steam so it shows as its own entry. Fan PC ports since 2008; Decay: Singularity (decay_single, single player with saves) and Solo Mission (decaysolodemo) are other versions.

entries.description: A fan port of the PlayStation 2 co-op expansion Half-Life: Decay to the PC Half-Life engine, with all ten missions in co-op or solo.

entries.name: OpenGOAL

games.title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy

needs.what: Your own PlayStation 2 disc of each Jak game as an .iso (or its extracted folder)

setup.notes: The launcher downloads the OpenGOAL game release (open-goal/jak-project) itself, then asks for the .iso per game and runs its extractor, which validates, decompiles and compiles the game. The game program gk is started by the launcher.

entries.description: The Jak and Daxter games decompiled from their PlayStation 2 GOAL code and running natively, installed and updated through the OpenGOAL Launcher.

entries.name: reLCS

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories

needs.what: The original game files of Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories (the folder holding MODELS/GTA3.IMG and the rest)

setup.place: the reLCS program goes inside the GTA LCS game folder and runs from there
setup.notes: Optional extras from the repo's gamefiles/ folder (controller mappings, button icons) are copied into the game folder too. Build with CMake (GLFW or SDL2).

saves: userfiles/GTAVCsf<n>.b (relative to the game folder, on Linux)
entries.description: A reverse-engineered rewrite of Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories, from the team behind re3 and reVC, that runs on top of the original game files.

entries.name: PT for PC

setup.notes: Free fan remake of the P.T. demo (about 1.6 GB) distributed on GameJolt; Windows only, so it would run through Proton.

entries.description: A free fan remake of the P.T. playable teaser for Windows, rebuilt from scratch without the original files.

entries.name: AC6 Recomp

needs.what: The US Xbox 360 disc of Ace Combat 6 as an .iso (or its files extracted into an assets folder)

setup.place: the .iso (any name) or an assets/ folder next to ac6recomp.exe; optional extracted DLC in dlc/
setup.notes: The image is picked by the game's title ID 4E4D07D1, so a wrong or damaged image is refused with a message. First run creates ac6recomp.toml beside the program. Needs AVX2 and Direct3D 12 (through Proton on Linux).

saves: Documents/ac6recomp inside the Proton prefix (ReXGlue user data folder: Windows Documents/<app name>)
entries.description: A static recompilation of the Xbox 360 Ace Combat 6 for Windows, built on the ReXGlue SDK, with 60 FPS and keyboard and mouse controls.

entries.name: BeanRecomp

games.title: GoldenEye 007 (Xbox Live Arcade remaster, codename Bean)

needs.what: The Xbox 360 GoldenEye 007 Remastered (Xbox Live version) executable, used at build time

setup.notes: Early groundwork only (PPC register handling, compiling the recompiled code); no runnable program and no releases. Last change March 2025.

entries.description: An early, unfinished static recompilation of the unreleased Xbox 360 GoldenEye 007 remaster using XenonRecomp, with nothing playable yet.

entries.name: Eternal Sonata: Reprise

needs.what: An Xbox 360 disc image (.iso) of Eternal Sonata, PAL, USA or Japanese release (USA and JP default.xex are patched into the PAL one); title updates optional

setup.notes: On first start it asks for the game (an ISO, or an already extracted folder) and extracts it into assets/ beside the program, then writes game_data_root to eternalsonata.toml. The extracted default.xex must match SHA-256 91184E77...949501E after patching. An empty portable.txt beside the program keeps saves there instead.

saves: ~/.local/share/eternalsonata (ReXGlue user folder: XDG_DATA_HOME/<app name>); user/ beside the program with portable.txt
entries.description: A static recompilation of Eternal Sonata for Xbox 360, built on a ReXGlue SDK fork, running natively on Linux and Windows with mod support.

entries.name: Fable2Recomp

needs.what: The Xbox 360 game files of Fable II (Game of the Year edition with title update 1) extracted into the assets folder

setup.place: assets/ (game files, needed at build time for code generation)
setup.notes: Work in progress with no releases: it has to be built from source with the ReXGlue SDK and the game's files.

entries.description: A work-in-progress static recompilation of Fable II for Xbox 360, built on the ReXGlue SDK, with no released builds yet.

entries.name: LARecomp

needs.what: Midnight Club: Los Angeles (Complete Edition, US Xbox 360) extracted from the disc: a folder holding default.xex and the xarchive_*.rpf archives, or the disc as an ISO for its install wizard

setup.place: MCLA_Game_Files/ (or game/ or assets/) next to the program or a folder above it, holding default.xex and xarchive_*.rpf
setup.notes: Also reads the MCLA_GAME_DATA environment variable. With no game data found, an ISO install wizard offers to extract the disc. A folder only counts with default.xex and at least one archive. Can import saves from Xenia or RPCS3 on first run. Recommended to run with --clock_no_scaling=true (works around a frame rate collapse) and REX_LOG_LEVEL=warn.

saves: Documents/larecomp inside the Proton prefix (ReXGlue user data folder)
entries.description: A static recompilation of the Xbox 360 Midnight Club: Los Angeles for Windows, built on the ReXGlue SDK, with correct physics above 30 FPS and an in-game settings menu.

entries.name: Lost Odyssey Recomp

needs.what: The four Xbox 360 discs of Lost Odyssey (title ID 4D5307FA), either the USA/Europe set or the Asian multilingual set, not mixed; disc 1 is enough to start. Extracted folders, default.xex, ISOs or Games on Demand data. No title updates or modified XEX.

setup.notes: An importer opens when no game is found and copies the discs into game/disc1..disc4 (and dlc/) in its data folder; other discs and DLC are added later in Settings, System, Import discs & DLC. --game <folder or default.xex> skips the importer. On first start it offers to download precompiled shaders. LO_NO_UPDATE=1 skips its update check.

entries.description: A native port of Lost Odyssey for Xbox 360 made with XenonRecomp, with high frame rates, modern upscalers, HDR and a debug menu.

entries.name: Marathon Recompiled

needs.what: Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) for Xbox 360 (not the PS3 version) dumped as containers/images or raw folders, with a Title Update of the same region; the episode and mission pack DLC are optional

setup.notes: Same installer wizard as Unleashed Recompiled (Add Files or Add Folder, original unmodified files only, disc and Title Update from the same region); writes game/, decrypted/ and dlc/ beside the program (Flatpak build: ~/.var/app/io.github.sonicnext_dev.marathonrecomp/data). --install forces the installer again. The README says it is still in development and not meant for public use; no releases exist.

entries.description: An unofficial PC port of the Xbox 360 Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) made by static recompilation, for Windows, Linux and macOS, still in development.

entries.name: OpenMBU

setup.notes: Complete game in the zip (scripts, missions, art), no game files needed. The release holds MBUltra.exe (32-bit), MBUltra64.exe and debug builds plus D3D9/OpenAL DLLs, so it runs through Proton. Linux builds exist only as CI artifacts.

saves: prefs.cs files in the game folder (marble/client/prefs.cs, written by Torque's export)
entries.description: A fan revival of the Xbox Live Arcade game Marble Blast Ultra on its original Torque engine source, with controller options, fan-made levels and Discord support.

entries.name: PGR4-Recomp

needs.what: Project Gotham Racing 4 for Xbox 360 extracted from the disc into a folder holding default.xex (a Games on Demand dump converted with god2iso first, then extracted with extract-xiso)

setup.notes: The game will not launch without --execute_unclipped_draw_vs_on_cpu --gpu_plugin="xenos" as well. The zip has one top folder, PGR4-Recomp-v1.2.1/, with pgr4_recomp.exe, rexruntime.dll, rexgpu-xenos*.dll and a run.bat holding the same arguments. The project's SteamOS steps use Proton Experimental. Quote the path (a game on another drive misbehaves otherwise).

saves: Documents/pgr4_recompiled inside the Proton prefix (ReXGlue user data folder)
entries.description: A work-in-progress static recompilation of the Xbox 360 Project Gotham Racing 4 for Windows, built on the ReXGlue SDK.

entries.name: rb2: Dragon Ball Z Budokai HD Recompiled

games.title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai HD Collection

needs.what: The Xbox 360 game files of Dragon Ball Z: Budokai HD (default.xex and the rest of the disc) extracted into a folder

setup.place: assets/ next to dbz1.exe (used when no path is given)
setup.notes: Takes the game folder (the one holding default.xex) as its first argument; without one it uses assets/ beside the program. Release is a single bare dbz1.exe, so it runs through Proton.

entries.description: An early static recompilation of Dragon Ball Z: Budokai HD for Xbox 360, built on the ReXGlue SDK.

entries.name: re:Blue

needs.what: Disc images of all three discs of the Global (US/EU) Xbox 360 release of Blue Dragon (.iso, or Games on Demand packages); DLC optional

setup.notes: First start opens a setup wizard that asks for each of the three disc images in turn (checked by title ID 4D5307DF), an install folder and a graphics preset, copies the game files into <install>/game/ and copies itself there. From the AppImage the default install folder is ~/.config/reblue. The install is recorded in ~/.config/reblue/install.toml. --repair reopens the wizard; --profile <name> picks a save profile. Japanese and Asian discs not supported yet.

saves: <install folder>/profiles/default/ (saves, reblue.toml settings, achievements); default install folder ~/.config/reblue
entries.description: A static recompilation of Blue Dragon for Xbox 360 built on the ReXGlue SDK, with high resolutions, unlocked frame rate, save anywhere, mods and DLC support.

entries.name: ReStuff

needs.what: Naughty Bear: Gold Edition for Xbox 360, with the disc's contents extracted straight into assets/ so that assets/Default.xex exists

setup.place: assets/ next to the program (the Linux build ships ReStuff-linux64/assets/PUT_GAME_FILES_HERE.txt); the files go directly in assets/, not a subfolder
setup.notes: Looks for assets/Default.xex from the working folder and the program's folder upwards. The Linux archive has one top folder, ReStuff-linux64/, with restuff, librexruntime.so, librexgpu-xenos.so and libshaderc_shared.so.1. prewarm_shaders.sh warms shader caches (optional). restuff.toml is created only if missing. The project's own instructions point to the Goopie launcher, which dumps the ISO.

entries.description: A static recompilation of the Xbox 360 Naughty Bear: Gold Edition built on the ReXGlue SDK, with a native Vulkan renderer, 60 FPS and optional cheats.

entries.name: ReTiP

needs.what: The retail Viva Pinata: Trouble in Paradise Xbox 360 disc as an .iso

setup.notes: On first run it asks for the .iso and extracts it (the public source looks for the game in assets/ beside the program, assets/default.xex). The Linux archive has no top folder: retip_ (the program), librexruntimerd.so, retip.toml, retip_pipelines.bin, rexcrashreporter and a retip/ folder. F5 opens the mod manager (Thunderstore browser), F4 the settings. Also on GameJolt, which adds GameJolt trophies.

entries.description: A static recompilation of the Xbox 360 Viva Pinata: Trouble in Paradise for Windows and Linux with a native renderer, unlocked frame rate and built-in mod support.

entries.name: Saints Reborn

needs.what: Your own Saints Row (Xbox 360) disc as an .iso, or a folder of its files holding default.xex and packfiles; only the disc version the port was made with is supported

setup.notes: Releases carry only SaintsReborn-Setup.exe, a Windows installer that downloads a 1.5 GB toolchain and compiles the game from your disc (10 to 60 minutes); the game ends up in dist/ with saintsrow.exe and WhompaysModLoader.exe. Linux Setup is 'coming soon' (to be played through Proton). Options are files beside saintsrow.exe (res_scale.txt, start_windowed, fps_cap.txt).

entries.description: An unofficial native Windows port of the Xbox 360 Saints Row, statically recompiled with the ReXGlue SDK and built on your own PC from your own disc, with co-op, 60 FPS and keyboard and mouse.

entries.name: Skate 2 Recompilation Project

needs.what: A legally obtained copy of Skate 2 for Xbox 360

setup.notes: Early-stage project using XenonRecomp; the README says it is no longer being worked on. No builds.

entries.description: An abandoned, early-stage attempt to recompile the Xbox 360 Skate 2 into a native program with XenonRecomp.

entries.name: Skate 3 Recomp

needs.what: Your own Xbox 360 Skate 3 disc as an .iso; the program extracts it and then stages Title Update 3 (downloaded for you, or a TU_12K2276_000000C000000.00000000000O3 package you pick)

setup.notes: First run shows 'Select ISO'; the disc is extracted into game/ beside the program (game/default.xex). Release builds also need Title Update 3 staged (game/default.xexp and game/data/webkit/EAWebkit.xexp, checked by SHA-256); the program downloads it from xboxunity.net by default. The Linux zip has one top folder, Skate3Recomp-Linux/, with skate3 and librexruntime.so. DLC packages go in a dlc/ folder. The author notes the Windows build through Proton may run better on some hardware.

saves: saves/ beside the program when that folder exists
the program's folder when portable.txt exists there
entries.description: An unofficial native recompilation of the Xbox 360 Skate 3 for Windows, Linux and macOS, with a native Direct3D 12 and Vulkan renderer, ultrawide and keyboard controls.

entries.name: SVR07-Recomp

needs.what: A retail WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2007 Xbox 360 disc (USA/Canada recommended), ripped and with its files extracted; a title update can go in assets/1_update

setup.place: assets/ next to svr07.exe, holding the extracted game files (assets/default.xex)
setup.notes: The zip has no top folder: svr07.exe, a small 'Smackdown vs Raw 2007.exe', README, LICENSE, DISCLAIMER. The code points the title update mount at \assets\1_update. Windows only (Direct3D 12), so it runs through Proton. About one session in ten ends in a GPU device-lost crash.

saves: Documents/svr07 inside the Proton prefix (ReXGlue user data folder)
entries.description: A static recompilation of the Xbox 360 WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2007 for Windows, built on a fork of the ReXGlue SDK, playable end to end at 60 FPS.

entries.name: Unleashed Recompiled

needs.what: Sonic Unleashed for Xbox 360 (US or EU, not JP), retail disc or digital copy, plus its Title Update; the Adventure Pack DLC are optional but recommended. Dumped from an Xbox 360 as containers/images or raw folders

setup.notes: The Linux release is a Flatpak bundle (io.github.hedge_dev.unleashedrecomp.flatpak inside the zip), installed with flatpak install; it installs game data only to ~/.var/app/io.github.hedge_dev.unleashedrecomp/data. First run opens an installer wizard (Add Files for containers or images, Add Folder for raw files) that checks the files against known hashes and writes game/, update/, patched/ and dlc/. In Game Mode on a Steam Deck the file picker may need one Desktop Mode boot first. EU copies are accepted too.

entries.description: An unofficial PC port of the Xbox 360 Sonic Unleashed made by static recompilation, for Windows and Linux, with high resolutions, ultrawide, high frame rates and modding.
